milestones.claim: Red/repro coverage proves outcome recording must be explicit.
milestones.doneMeans: Smoke assertions cover explicit recording, DONE success is not helped, and helped without concrete exposure/verdict is rejected.

milestones.claim: Learning-store type layer defines outcome records and allowed outcome semantics.
milestones.doneMeans: Leaf types expose playbook outcome records and distinguish observability outcomes from decisive helped/dismissed/harmful samples.

milestones.claim: Learning-store persistence appends validated outcome records safely.
milestones.doneMeans: Outcome ledger helpers append records under the shared owner root, preserve existing records, and reject malformed input without corruption.

milestones.claim: Host-neutral command records outcomes without activation or gate evidence.
milestones.doneMeans: playbook_outcome_record records explicit outcomes, prints authority non_authoritative and gateEvidence false, and leaves candidate status unchanged.

milestones.claim: Command metadata and process facts classify outcome recording as audit-only metadata.
milestones.doneMeans: Command catalog, command policy, and process fact registry include the host-neutral command with no Codex/Claude namespace alias and no gate evidence semantics.
